name: siteos
description: SiteOS agent skills for search, forms, and analytics workflows in external web projects.

interface.shortDescription: Build and operate SiteOS-managed search, forms, and analytics
interface.longDescription: SiteOS provides agent skills for connecting external projects to SiteOS, scaffolding managed search and forms, syncing source data, delivering runtime UI, and inspecting analytics or diagnostics without exposing credentials.
defaultPrompt: $siteos-search inspect this external project and configure managed search
$siteos-forms add a managed contact form to this project
$siteos-analytics inspect search health and usage for this linked project
